Privacy policy

Last updated: 19 November 2026

This policy explains what information Sabri Logistics ("we", "us") collects when you book or receive a consignment with us, and how we use it.

Information we collect

  • Consignment details: consignor and consignee names, GST numbers, places of origin and destination, invoice and e-way bill numbers, description, quantity, weight and charges of the goods.
  • Contact details: the consignor's mobile / WhatsApp number, if you give it to us.
  • Staff accounts: names and phone numbers of our employees who use our booking system.

How we use it

  • To book, transport and deliver your goods, and to print the GC receipt, lorry receipt and delivery slip.
  • To send your GC receipt (a PDF) and booking updates to the WhatsApp number you gave us, through the WhatsApp Business Platform provided by Meta.
  • For accounting, GST and legal record-keeping.

We do not sell your information and we do not use it for advertising. We do not send marketing messages on WhatsApp.

WhatsApp messages

If you give us your WhatsApp number at booking, you agree to receive messages about that consignment from our business number +91 92749 77143. To stop, reply "STOP" or tell any branch, and we will not message you again.

Who we share it with

  • The consignee and our drivers see the details printed on their copy of the GC receipt.
  • Service providers who run our systems: Supabase (database), Vercel (website hosting), Cloudflare (message sending) and Meta Platforms (WhatsApp).
  • Government authorities when the law requires it (for example GST or e-way bill rules).

How long we keep it

Booking records are kept in our online system for 60 days and then deleted automatically. A monthly copy is kept offline for our accounts, as long as tax law requires.

Security

Our system is only for signed-in staff, each branch sees only its own records, passwords are stored encrypted, and all connections use HTTPS.

Your choices

You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information, or to stop WhatsApp messages, by contacting us below.
